preconditions.description: The input is a single integer n representing the number of vertices in a complete undirected graph, where 3 ≤ n ≤ 300.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (all(line.strip() != '' for line in stdout.splitlines()) and int(stdout.splitlines()[0].strip()) >= 1 and int(stdout.splitlines()[0].strip()) <= int(stdin.strip())**2)
postconditions.description: If no valid solution exists, output is exactly '-1'. Otherwise, the first line is an integer k (1 ≤ k ≤ n²) representing the number of cycles, followed by k lines describing cycles of length 3 or 4.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(len(line.split()) == 3 or len(line.split()) == 4 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each cycle description line starts with an integer m (3 or 4) followed by m integers representing vertices in traversal order.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(1 <= int(v) <= int(stdin.strip()) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] for v in line.split()[1:])
postconditions.description: All vertex indices in cycle descriptions are within the valid range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(len(set(line.split()[1:])) == len(line.split()[1:]) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each cycle contains distinct vertices (no repeated vertices except the first and last, which are the same in a closed cycle).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(any((int(line.split()[i+1]) == int(line.split()[i+2]) and int(line.split()[i]) == int(line.split()[i+1])) or (int(line.split()[i+1]) == int(line.split()[i+2]) and int(line.split()[i]) == int(line.split()[i+2])) for i in range(len(line.split())-2)) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each cycle is a valid simple cycle (closed loop with no repeated edges except the first and last).

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(3 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 4 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each cycle has length exactly 3 or 4.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() != '-1' and all(all(1 <= i < j <= int(stdin.strip()) for i in range(1, int(stdin.strip())+1) for j in range(i+1, int(stdin.strip())+1)) and all((i,j) in edges for i in range(1, int(stdin.strip())+1) for j in range(i+1, int(stdin.strip())+1)) and all(edges.count((i,j)) == 2 for i in range(1, int(stdin.strip())+1) for j in range(i+1, int(stdin.strip())+1)))
postconditions.description: For n ≥ 3, every edge (i,j) where 1 ≤ i < j ≤ n appears in exactly two cycles in the solution. Here, edges is the multiset of edges derived from all cycles in the output.
